english.title: Use vehicle with obligatory rear reflector obscured
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not so constructed that at least part of the apparent surface of the

(A)_[nearside ]_
(B)_[offside ]_
(C)_[nearside and offside ]_

rear retro reflector required to be fitted by the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 would be visible when the vehicle was viewed from a point directly behind the reflector with every moveable part of the vehicle in a fixed open position
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 19 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use a vehicle on a road constructed so that the nearside /offside
rear retro reflector required to be fitted
was not visible from a point directly in front/behind the reflector
with every moveable part of the vehicle in a fixed open position

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The meaning of "every movable part" is 'every door, tailgate, boot lid, engine cover, cab or other moveable part'.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3076, H3078, H3079, H3080, H3081, H3082, H3085 and H3086.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was so constructed that part of the surface of the **(..SPECIFY WHICH REFLECTOR(S)..) **(..SPECIFY 'WAS' OR 'WERE'..) not visible when the vehicle was viewed from a point directly behind the reflector when a moveable part of the vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY PART..) was in a fixed open position.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
